name: NoteMind
description: PDF research workspace with Jina AI embeddings, Appwrite authentication and private storage.

DATABASE_URL.description: Deployment PostgreSQL connection string. The release phase applies the DocuMind schema to this database.

APPWRITE_ENDPOINT.description: Your Appwrite endpoint, including /v1, such as https://<REGION>.cloud.appwrite.io/v1.

APPWRITE_PROJECT_ID.description: The Appwrite project shared by authentication and PDF storage.

APPWRITE_API_KEY.description: Server-only Appwrite API key with the permissions needed for email-code authentication and private PDF storage.

APPWRITE_STORAGE_BUCKET_ID.description: Private PDF bucket with file security enabled, PDF-only uploads and a 25 MiB maximum file size.

CHROMA_TENANT.description: Chroma Cloud tenant containing the document index.

CHROMA_DATABASE.description: Chroma Cloud database containing the document index.

GROQ_API_KEY.description: Groq API key for generating answers.

DOCUMIND_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER.description: This Heroku deployment uses Jina AI for both indexing and retrieval.

JINA_API_KEY.description: Jina AI API key used by the API and PDF worker.

JINA_EMBEDDING_MODEL.description: Jina model used by the existing index, with 1024-dimensional output.

RUN_MIGRATIONS.description: Migrations run during the Heroku release phase instead of web startup.

NEW_RELIC_LICENSE_KEY.description: Optional New Relic license key; instrumentation stays off when empty.
